Class GameResultDAO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.DB.GameResultDAO
public class GameResultDAO extends Object
Data Access Object (DAO) for persisting and retrieving GameResult instances.

Provides CRUD operations against the game_results table in the database managed by DBManager. The connection is obtained from DBManager.getConnection() and is intentionally not closed by this class, since its lifecycle is managed externally by DBManager.

All methods that interact with the database declare SQLException and expect the caller to handle or propagate it. Before invoking any method, callers should verify that the database is available via DBManager.isActive().

  • Method Details

    • getConnection

      private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException
      Returns the active database connection from DBManager.

      The returned connection is shared and managed by DBManager;

      Returns:
      the current Connection
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the connection is null or unavailable

    • save

      public void save(GameResult result) throws SQLException
      Persists a GameResult to the game_results table.

      Inserts a new row with the player's nickname, score, and number of players. The game_date column is set to the current database server time via NOW()

      The underlying connection is obtained from DBManager and is not closed after this operation.

      Parameters:
      result - the GameResult to save; must not be null, and its nickname must not be null
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the connection is unavailable

    • getLeaderboard

      public List<GameResult> getLeaderboard(int numPlayers) throws SQLException
      Retrieves the leaderboard for games played with a specific number of players, ordered by score in descending order.

      Each row in the result set is mapped to a GameResult instance, including its game_date timestamp. The list is ordered from highest to lowest score.

      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the number of players used to filter the leaderboard entries
      Returns:
      a List of GameResult objects ordered by points descending; never null, but may be empty if no matching records exist
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the connection is unavailable

    • getPlayerPosition

      public int getPlayerPosition(String nickname, int numPlayers) throws SQLException
      Returns the 1-based leaderboard position of a player for games with a given number of participants.

      Fetches all records for the specified numPlayers value, ordered by score descending, and iterates through them to find the first entry whose nickname matches the given value. If multiple records exist for the same nickname, only the highest-scoring one determines the position.

      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname to look up; must not be null
      numPlayers - the number of players used to filter the leaderboard
      Returns:
      the 1-based position of the player in the leaderboard, or -1 if no matching record is found
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the connection is unavailable

    • clearAll

      public void clearAll() throws SQLException
      Deletes all records from the game_results table.

      This operation is irreversible. It affects all rows regardless of nickname, score, or player count. Intended for administrative use or test cleanup only.

      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs or the connection is unavailable
